notes: In compounds, it is often voiced as -guchi and means 'entrance' or 'exit' (e.g., 入口 iriguchi, 出口 deguchi).
Used in many common idioms relating to speech (口が堅い, tight-lipped) and taste (口に合う, to suit one's taste).

notes: While 'kuchi' primarily refers to the mouth on a face, it is also frequently used to describe any opening or entrance to a space, such as a doorway or an exit.
Be careful not to confuse this with 'kuchi' used in phrases related to personal preference or taste (kuchi ni au), which are common idiomatic uses.
